en.headline: John Lee meets Peking University party secretary on higher-education cooperation
en.dek: The Chief Executive discussed Northern Metropolis university-town plans and deeper collaboration through the Beijing-Hong Kong Universities Alliance.
body: Chief Executive John Lee met Peking University Party Secretary He Guangcai on Wednesday morning to exchange views on Hong Kong–mainland higher-education cooperation, talent cultivation and research collaboration.

Lee said on social media that the government is accelerating Northern Metropolis development and has reserved sufficient land for a university town, aiming to enhance higher education, research and innovation and attract international talent. He thanked Peking University for supporting the university-town plan and welcomed closer partnership with local universities.

The two sides discussed development models for the Northern Metropolis university town. Lee said he was encouraged by Peking University’s support for deeper Beijing–Hong Kong higher-education cooperation and looked forward to continued work through the Beijing-Hong Kong Universities Alliance.

zh.headline: 李家超晤北大黨委書記 談高等教育合作及北都大學城
zh.dek: 雙方就推動港與內地高等教育合作、培育人才及科研協作交流，李家超歡迎北大與本地大學協同發展。
body: 行政長官李家超星期三早上與北京大學黨委書記何光彩會面，就推動香港與內地高等教育合作、培育國際人才及加強科研協作等議題交流意見。
李家超在社交平台表示，政府正着力提速推進北部都會區發展，並已預留充足土地規劃大學城，透過提質擴容完善高等教育、科研創新及人才培訓配套，吸引更多國際高端人才。他感謝北大支持北都大學城發展，歡迎北大多與本地大學合作。
會面期間雙方就北都大學城發展模式交流。李家超對北大積極支持深化京港高等教育合作感到鼓舞，期待繼續通過京港大學聯盟促進兩地大學優勢互補。
